featured_reviews.name: Second Favorite
featured_reviews.review_text:
The only missing thing in MaKaBo's Mahavir Nagar khaugully is a Cafe where you can unwind and chill with your friends.

This cutesy cafe is all about chill vibes, great decor & sumptuous desserts & food.

AMBIANCE
Pastel shades, colorful wall murals, gorgeous wall mirrors and little frames - aptly describing my love for desserts 😋 Exactly a place you want to spend your afternoons, watching the rain pour outside 🌧️

FOOD
I believe in the quote, " Life's short!" So I started with a dessert 😋🤭

I went a little crazy looking at so many delicious options... You will know why, as you read through...

❤️ Brownie Nutella Waffle 🍫
Who doesn't like waffles, especially when it's loaded with chocolate?! Freshly baked waffle topped with milk and white chocolate chips, rice crisps and brownie crumbs.
#MustHave

❤️ Peri Peri Fries (Jain)
Long, crispy and unbelievable good. I never imagined Banana fries could taste good. Thancos surely has a secret to making some delicious Jain items. I tried this on the owner's recommendation &  it was totally worth it.
#WorthaTry

❤️ Fruity Exotica Waffle 🧇
After a delightful chocolaty experience, I couldn't stop at one. So I decided to indulge in the exotic fruity Waffles. So I wasn't too sure about how a fruity  waffle would be like. But this one was so good. Topped with fresh papaya, kiwi and pineapple & whipped cream, I got a sweet and tangy twist to my waffle and the best part it wasn't so sinful.
#yummy

❤️ Farm Fresh Pizza 🍕
I never miss a chance to have a pizza. I loved the trim crust pizza with toppings of bellpeppers, olives, jalapenos, babycorn and onions. It was a melt-in-the-mouth experience with a combination cheese of mozzarella, cheddar and processed cheese. It was an absolute delight.
#SFFWrecommends

🌰 NUTSHELL REVIEW
Head over to Thancos for a perfect evening with friends or family. Great snacks, droolworthy desserts and fantastic ambiance.
They are introducing some amazing rolls, burgers, bubble waffles and freakshakes. Can't wait to visit again 🥰

Dessertino - Located In mahavir nagar, this place serves tasty and amazing thick shakes, milk shakes, waffles, ice cream and more.. it's a small outlet with limited seating arrangement (indoor as well as outdoor). Mr. Dev (staff) was helpful in selecting the waffles and thick shakes.

I had :

GO MAN THICK SHAKE : it's just perfect, definitely a go to for all mango lovers.. the shake is really thick and sweet and topped with freshly chopped pieces of mangoes .. one of the best thick shakes i ever had..

2019 SHAKE : it's a chocolate base thick shake.. it's really thick and tasty.. topped with whipped cream, pieces of brownie, kit- Kat, Oreo biscuits and choco -chips.. the quantity was good.. value for money..

For Normal milkshake I had PURE PISTACHIO MILKSHAKE : wanted to try a new flavor and it wasn't a disappointed.. it was good in taste ..

And lastly I had MUD PIE WAFFLE : it was served hot and freshly prepared.. it had both Chocolate and vanilla base.. topped with brownie.. it was good in taste..

Would recommend all the things I tried and will definitely visit again..

featured_reviews.name: Jewel Cecilia Vaz
featured_reviews.review_text:
No better way to beat the summer is to try this super cool outlet called DESSERTINO at the heart of mahavir nagar which is a 10mins ride by rick from Kandivali Station.

The dessert parlour can accommodate two groups inside with seating available outside too.

Coming to the service, it was quick. The staff were patient also at the same time helped in suggesting & recommending what to try.

Coming to the dishes I went for

The GoMan milkshake : This shake is a must try given its a mango milkshake and it can't go wrong in beating the summer. The milkshake was quite thick with huge chunks mangoes in it.. There was no ice added so you get the exact taste of the shake.

The DOrea milkshake was good it had whipcream mixed with orea and to end it off with the orea biscuit itself to justify with the shakes name.

The Sunny caramel could have been better the choco chips were alot and somehow was overpowering the shake ( based on my taste could differ from person to person)

The gummy bubble shake are for all the boomer fans this shake totally justifies it with the name.. It was PERFECT.

I tried the wafflea and they were freshly made in front of us.
I went for the Pistashio waffle it was really good with Pistashio ice cream inbetween the waffles with fresh Pistashio on it. It was really awesome and would definitely recommend it.

The mud pie was good could have been better somehow I felt it got abit dry cause of the brownie it could hve been goeey. So the mud pie had dark chocolate & white chocolate along with brownie.

Overall my experience was good and I shall definitely be visiting this place to beat the heat with their super cool milkshakes

Coming to the Quantity first, the quantity was amazing considering the cost and since Amul Ice-creams are made of pure milk. The taste was just super delicious. For those of you have actually tasted the Rajbhog sweet you will notice that the ice-cream tastes almost the same. And with the addition of all those dry fruits, it just gives the ice cream a slightly crunchier texture on the smoothness.

All in all the taste was super awesome and you can visibly notice the difference in the taste of ice-creams made of pure milk and ice-creams denoted as frozen desserts when you have this one. Simply said amazing taste and you will definitely be satisfied after having this. Highly recommended.
